SELECT CORP_KEY CORP_KEY2, * FROM
D360.STG_EDS_CRM_CORPORATE WHERE CORP_KEY='C00008201'
UNION ALL
SELECT CORP_KEY CORP_KEY2, * FROM
D360.STG_EDS_CRM_CORPORATE WHERE CORP_KEY='C00113453'
UNION ALL
SELECT CORP_KEY CORP_KEY2, * FROM
D360.STG_EDS_CRM_CORPORATE WHERE CORP_KEY='C00065217'
UNION ALL
SELECT CORP_KEY CORP_KEY2, * FROM
D360.STG_EDS_CRM_CORPORATE WHERE CORP_KEY='999999'




CORP_KEY='C00008201' (UPDATED) .
CORP_KEY='C00113453' (DELETED) . 
CORP_KEY='C00065217' (UNCHANGED) .
CORP_KEY='999999' (NEW RECORD) . 

select CORP_KEY CORP_KEY2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT CORP_KEY CORP_KEY2, * FROM
EDS.CRM_CORPORATE WHERE CORP_KEY='C00008201'
UNION ALL
SELECT CORP_KEY CORP_KEY2, * FROM
EDS.CRM_CORPORATE WHERE CORP_KEY='C00113453'
UNION ALL
SELECT CORP_KEY CORP_KEY2, * FROM
EDS.CRM_CORPORATE WHERE CORP_KEY='C00065217'
UNION ALL
SELECT CORP_KEY CORP_KEY2, * FROM
EDS.CRM_CORPORATE WHERE CORP_KEY='999999' ) temp order by CORP_KEY, SCD_START_DATE
